scene: The green battery hums in your lap, powering three transit gates.
picture: Flat side view on a level concrete platform. A South Asian girl with a long black braid in a teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair holding a glowing green battery. On the left, a yellow airship is moored to a ramp. In the centre, a glass elevator stands open. On the right, a red steam engine puffs clouds.
